- Factor *Wait Credit Rate … When the Note Rate Has Changed*: rate_change_date 2026-09-14 after closed date 2026-05-15 → note 6.61 + 0.50 = 7.11.
- Factor *Wait Period Counted in Whole Months*: 2026-05-15 → 2026-10-15 = 5 whole months (>3) → 5/12.
